A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 19-page paper, including readable equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–B. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the manuscript content is identical apart from the first-page arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original Gaussian-data experiments, image-classification robustness evaluations, ablations, and repeated-run results in Section 3.3, Section 5, and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains those original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons in Tables 1–9 and five-run results in Appendix B.4, Table 10.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same balanced-subset self-teacher training followed by adversarial training with balanced softmax and self-distillation. No algorithm steps, objectives, or components change.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic Gaussian classification data, CIFAR-10-LT, CIFAR-100-LT, and Tiny-ImageNet-LT. Dataset, task, and test-scenario coverage is unchanged throughout the main text and Appendix B.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain PGD-AT, TRADES, MART, AWP, RoBal, REAT, and AT-BSL. Comparator membership also remains identical in the augmentation, teacher-selection, and extended-training experiments.

E3.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix B retain identical architectures, training budgets, preprocessing, imbalance ratios, and evaluation procedures. These include 10-step PGD training, 20-step PGD and AutoAttack evaluation, and best/last checkpoint reporting.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 and Appendix B retain the same augmentation, imbalance-ratio, balanced-subset, teacher-choice, extended-training, hyperparameter-sensitivity, and class-wise robustness analyses. No analysis or supporting evidence is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix B.4 and Table 10 report the same five runs, averages, and standard deviations in both versions. Run-count disclosure and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All results in Tables 1–10 and Figures 1–8 are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains the proposed method's best-checkpoint clean, PGD, and AutoAttack accuracies of 46.13, 22.42, and 18.73, respectively.

T1.justification: Section 3 retains the same error definitions, Gaussian-mixture assumptions, Theorem 1, and Corollary 1. Appendix A's two lemmas and proof derivations are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion make identical claims about tail-class vulnerability, the two-stage self-distillation contribution, and improved overall and tail-class robustness. No contribution is strengthened, narrowed, or redefined.

C2.justification: Both retain the same interpretations of balanced-subset teachers and the accuracy–robustness tradeoff. The conclusion's limitation concerning data quantity versus intrinsic class difficulty, and its class-fairness future direction, are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures are identical, including 30 teacher-training epochs, 100 main-training epochs, batch sizes 32/128, SGD settings, and resampling instructions. No code or data access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations throughout the manuscript, and the reference list are identical. Positioning relative to adversarial distillation and long-tailed adversarial training is unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv:2503.06461v1, dated 9 Mar 2025, to arXiv:2503.06461v2, dated 3 Aug 2025. Manuscript wording, headings, section order, and appendix structure remain identical.

P2.justification: All eight figures and ten tables retain identical formatting, captions, and placement. Rendered pages 2–19 match exactly; the first-page difference is confined to the administrative stamp text, with the manuscript layout unchanged.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, results, proofs, and appendix analyses are identical. v2 updates the arXiv stamp, adds a hyperlink to that stamp, and changes PDF metadata. These administrative differences do not meaningfully alter the paper's rigor, clarity, evidential support, or reproducibility.
